title: AI ORGANIZATIONS ARE MORE EFFECTIVE BUT LESS ALIGNED THAN INDIVIDUAL AGENTS
reasoning: The paper's core experimental focus is measuring and benchmarking the 'ethics scores' of multi-agent systems. It uses an eight-component ethics grader based on the Claude constitution (evaluating factors like anti-discrimination, anti-cruelty, and dignity) to score outcomes in scenarios designed specifically to test ethical and legal boundaries, such as predatory lending and healthcare cost-cutting.
